关于摄影社的故事(A Story about the photo club): 一篇关于兴趣爱好的A2短文:汤姆与伊娃的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the photo club by bike. Last Thursday, Tom and Eva went to the photo club. Tom usually has noodles for breakfast. Her palette leans to sea blues.
They took many photos at the model workbench. Tom plays basketball with Eva every Thursday. Eva is interested in singing. Their new album comes out in May.
Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the model workbench. Tom wants to be a engineer in the future. Best of all, the singer walked onto the stage.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Tom thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. The photo club is one of the best places in the city.
